thesis: Predictive memory groups histories by relevant futures and must preserve compatible updating.

ideas.statement: Histories inducing the same relevant future distribution can share a state, subject to closure under new observations.
Approximate closeness is not transitive, so repeated merges need class-wide and propagated error control.

evidenceAndExamples.statement: A modulo-three counter handles histories that a fixed recent window cannot distinguish.

objectionsAndQualifications.statement: Hidden generator simplicity does not guarantee a simple observer belief state; informational compression need not be cheap to compute.

audit.notes: Complete batch read; headings and navigation excluded from idea ranking.
